description: Shear Behavior of UHPC Considering Axial Load and Fiber Alignment is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). The superior mechanical properties of ultra-high-performance concrete (UHPC) allow for the design of thinner, longer-span structural elements with or without traditional reinforcing bars. This research study investigated the shear behavior of UHPC, considering the effects of axial stress fields and fiber alignment. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Ultra-high-performance concrete,  UHPC, Universal Panel Tester, axial load effects,  shear behavior, direct tension test. Published 2024-12-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
